provenance: Synthetic pre-sales product and solution statements created for Phase 1 evaluation.

chunks.text: Aurora Edge X-200 supports offline deployment. Offline mode does not include automatic cloud upgrades and requires quarterly manual patches.
Each Aurora Edge X-200 node supports up to 500 concurrent devices. Capacity is not unlimited; larger deployments require additional nodes.
Nimbus Insight has a 99.9% availability target. Planned maintenance and customer network outages are excluded from the target.
Nimbus Insight v2.1 exports CSV and JSON. It does not support bulk PDF export.
生产线方案支持 OPC UA 和 Modbus。单网关最多连接 128 个传感器，不支持无线设备自动配网。
零售门店方案每 15 分钟同步库存。断网时可缓存 24 小时，网络恢复后自动补传。
Atlas Vault uses AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Customer-managed encryption keys are supported.
Atlas Vault 数据驻留区域仅限法兰克福和新加坡，不支持跨区域自动复制。
A standard migration takes 3 to 5 business days. The rollback snapshot is retained for 7 days.
A synthetic factory reported an 18% downtime reduction during a 12-week pilot. This result is not guaranteed for other deployments.
Administrator access supports SAML 2.0 single sign-on and requires multi-factor authentication.
The REST API limit is 100 requests per second and returns HTTP 429 above the limit. Webhooks use at-least-once delivery, so duplicates are possible.
